{{Spoiler}}

'''Crimson stroganoff''' is the secret meal of the [[Crimson Fungus|crimson fungus]]. It heals {{Value|Crimson Stroganoff|heals}} and gives {{EffectLink|Weakness}} for {{Value|Crimson Stroganoff|duration|effect=Weakness}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/crimson_stroganoff.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Crimson fungus, a [[steak]], dough, a milk bottle and a bowl. The recipe is secret. The milk bottle's glass bottle isn't returned (see [[Known bugs]]).

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Crimson Stroganoff|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Crimson Stroganoff|heals}} and gives Weakness {{Value|Crimson Stroganoff|level|effect=Weakness}} for {{Value|Crimson Stroganoff|duration|effect=Weakness|format=clock}}. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?'' The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_10.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
